adjudication.rationale: Verified in the diff: Admin::GroupsController#add_members and #remove_member both render only `success_json` (no updated members/meta payload). On the client, Discourse.Group#addMembers and #removeMember explicitly call `self.findMembers()` in their `.then(...)` handlers, which triggers a second request to `/groups/:name/members.json` to refresh state. This is an efficiency/architecture concern (extra round trip), not a correctness defect.
